terbaru.judul: Towards Temporal-Aware Multi-Modal Retrieval Augmented Generation in Finance
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we introduce FinTMMBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating temporal-aware multi-modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems in finance.

terbaru.judul: Are Large Language Models Good In-context Learners for Financial Sentiment Analysis?
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we aim to answer the fundamental question: whether LLMs are good in-context learners for FSA?

terbaru.judul: Large language models in finance : what is financial sentiment?
terbaru.pelajaran: Financial sentiment has become a crucial yet complex concept in finance, increasingly used in market forecasting and investment strategies.

terbaru.judul: Advanced Deep Learning Techniques for Analyzing Earnings Call Transcripts: Methodologies and Applications
terbaru.pelajaran: This study presents a comparative analysis of deep learning methodologies such as BERT, FinBERT and ULMFiT for sentiment analysis of earnings call transcripts.

terbaru.judul: Market-Derived Financial Sentiment Analysis: Context-Aware Language Models for Crypto Forecasting
terbaru.pelajaran: Aggregating daily tweet predictions into trading signals, our method outperformed traditional fusion models (which combine sentiment-based and price-based predictions).

terbaru.judul: FinRLlama: A Solution to LLM-Engineered Signals Challenge at FinRL Contest 2024
terbaru.pelajaran: In response to Task II of the FinRL Challenge at ACM ICAIF 2024, this study proposes a novel prompt framework for fine-tuning large language models (LLM) with Reinforcement Learning from Market Feedback (RLMF).

terbaru.judul: An End-To-End LLM Enhanced Trading System
terbaru.pelajaran: This project introduces an end-to-end trading system that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) for real-time market sentiment analysis.
This paper explores a multimodal machine learning approach for stock price prediction by combining data from diverse sources, including traditional financial metrics, tweets, and news articles.

terbaru.judul: Sentiment trading with large language models
terbaru.pelajaran: We analyze a dataset comprising 965,375 news articles that span from January 1, 2010, to June 30, 2023; we focus on the performance of various LLMs, including BERT, OPT, FINBERT, and the traditional Loughran-McDonald dictionary model, which has been a dominant methodology in the finance literature.

terbaru.judul: Multimodal Deep Reinforcement Learning for Portfolio Optimization
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that leverages multimodal data including historical stock prices, sentiment analysis, and topic embeddings from news articles, to optimize trading strategies for SP100 stocks.
